title: Accepted direct time samples can report valid wall clock with NO_SYNC stratum
description: Correctness review: TimeProvider.sample defaults stratum=None, so valid Manual, RTC, or Local-client samples can be adopted while TimeStatus reports wall_clock_valid=True and Stratum.NO_SYNC. This contradicts NO_SYNC being monotonic-only and creates incoherent DIO advertisement. Require a defined quality/stratum for every authoritative sample or explicitly separate local-valid from advertisable status; prohibit valid wall clock plus NO_SYNC.
